Response A stays under the 120-word limit at about 115 words including the title. Response B runs to about 127 words, so it breaks the user's explicit constraint.

Both responses cover the same key terms. Response A also keeps the per-page overage rates (0.9c and 6.5c), which a manager needs to judge cost risk. Its only omission is the contact name, a minor detail. Response B adds the contact but goes over the limit to do it.
